gotcha: Dynamically setting Slack channel from webhook data via expression triggers the multiOptions whitespace bug — any leading/trailing space in the expression value causes a raw TypeError (issue #31215).
workaround: Use a Switch node to route based on webhook data (e.g., customer tier), with each branch going to a separate Slack node with a hardcoded channel name. This avoids dynamic expressions in the Slack channel field entirely.

gotcha: OpenAI credential test itself fails with 'setContentType is not a function' on n8n Cloud 2.19-2.21 (issues #30349, #30311), blocking any workflow that uses the native OpenAI node.
workaround: Use HTTP Request node with Header Auth credential (Authorization: Bearer <api-key>) to call the OpenAI API directly. This bypasses the broken credential injection path in the native OpenAI node.

gotcha: Official Supabase node rejects valid API credentials with 'Authorization failed' error (n8n 2.20.9), even though the same key works via HTTP Request, community nodes, and direct curl.
workaround: Use HTTP Request node to call the Supabase REST API directly with the API key in an Authorization header, instead of the native Supabase node.

gotcha: IF node evaluates correctly during manual testing but routes to the wrong branch in production execution mode, especially with complex conditions or when called from sub-workflows.
workaround: Warn about the known IF node reliability issue in production mode. For critical routing, consider using a Code node to evaluate conditions explicitly and output to different branches, or use Switch node which has fewer reported production-mode issues.

gotcha: Nested AgentToolV3 with Redis Chat Memory causes corrupted message history — OpenAI rejects conversations with 'invalid tool message ordering' after a few turns (issue #31860). Clearing Redis temporarily fixes it but error returns.
workaround: Use Postgres Chat Memory or Window Buffer Memory instead of Redis Chat Memory when using nested agent tools. Postgres memory does not exhibit the message ordering corruption.

gotcha: Loop Over Items / SplitInBatches node processes only the first item, repeats the first item for all iterations, or silently skips items after a threshold — causing data loss in batch processing pipelines. Nested loops are especially broken.
workaround: Use a Code node to implement batch processing manually with explicit array slicing and iteration, instead of relying on Loop Over Items for large datasets (500+ contacts).

gotcha: Merge node does not block/wait for both branches to complete — it may fire with only one input populated, sending incomplete data downstream, or return empty output if one branch has no data.
workaround: Warn about the Merge node timing issue. Ensure both branches are triggered from the same source, or use a Wait node before the Merge to synchronize branches. For complex merging, use a Code node to manually combine data from both sources.

gotcha: Webhook may not correctly parse uploaded binary files (PDFs), and the Respond to Webhook node may return an empty response before AI summarization completes.
workaround: Set Respond to Webhook node's response mode to 'When Last Node Finishes' instead of default. Add explicit binary data handling in a Code node to verify the file was parsed. For long-running AI processing, consider responding immediately with a job ID and using a callback pattern.

gotcha: Notion node 'Get Many' with formula filter fails with 'Unable to filter based on a formula of unknown type' even when Return Type is specified (reported May 2026). The node doesn't correctly pass formula sub-type to the Notion API.
workaround: Use HTTP Request node to query the Notion API directly with a properly formatted filter body, or retrieve all rows with the Notion node (no filter) and filter locally using an IF, Filter, or Code node.

gotcha: When using 'Continue with Error Output', the paired item data is lost on the error branch — expressions referencing the original input data fail with 'Paired item data unavailable' (issue #30050).
workaround: Store a copy of the original input data in a Set node BEFORE the error-prone step. On the error branch, reference the stored data instead of trying to access paired items from the failed node.

gotcha: OpenAI file upload via the native node fails with 'connection closed unexpectedly' due to malformed multipart/form-data in n8n 2.10+ (regression from 2.2.4).
workaround: Use HTTP Request node to upload files to the OpenAI API directly with proper multipart form encoding, instead of the native OpenAI upload node.

gotcha: Schedule Trigger timezone depends on the GENERIC_TIMEZONE env var which many self-hosted users miss. Combined with the Wait node regression (issue #29160), scheduled workflows may fire at the wrong time or hang indefinitely.
workaround: Warn about GENERIC_TIMEZONE configuration requirement for self-hosted n8n. Suggest explicitly setting timezone in the Schedule Trigger node configuration. Avoid Wait node for critical delayed operations — use a separate scheduled workflow instead.

gotcha: After n8n update to v2.23.2, shared credentials no longer appear in the node editor dropdown for other team members (issue #31682). Existing workflows still execute but new nodes cannot be configured with shared credentials.
workaround: This is a platform regression (fix in PR #31938). Warn users about the credential visibility issue after updates. As a workaround, the credential owner can configure the node and share the workflow, rather than sharing the credential for others to configure.

gotcha: MongoDB Update/Find-and-Update node shows correct output in n8n but the actual database record is not modified — dynamic field references from previous nodes are treated as literal strings instead of resolved values.
workaround: Use a Code node to construct the MongoDB update query with properly resolved field values, then pass it to the MongoDB node or use HTTP Request to call the MongoDB API directly.

gotcha: Merge node in Combine mode silently loses rows when merging results back with original data, especially when one branch produces fewer output items (e.g., some emails fail validation).
workaround: Use a Code node to manually merge arrays by a shared key (like email address), handling mismatched counts explicitly instead of relying on Merge node's Combine mode.

gotcha: Execute Workflow (sub-workflow) node may receive data but fail to pass results back to parent, or throw ECONNREFUSED errors. Parent receives empty output from sub-workflows that actually executed successfully.
workaround: Warn about the known sub-workflow output passing issue. Consider inlining the sub-workflow logic into the parent workflow, or using webhook-based communication between workflows for critical data passing. For orchestration, have sub-workflows write results to a shared database that the parent reads.

gotcha: Respond to Webhook node fires before downstream processing (Stripe payment) completes, returning empty JSON to the caller instead of waiting for the payment result.
workaround: Set the webhook's Response Mode to 'responseNode' (uses Respond to Webhook node) or 'lastNode', NOT the default 'Immediately'. Ensure the Respond to Webhook node is positioned AFTER all Stripe processing in the workflow.

param_checks.description: Webhook responseMode must be 'responseNode' or 'lastNode', not 'Immediately' (the default that causes early response)

gotcha: Google OAuth callback URL mismatch (redirect_uri_mismatch) when n8n runs behind Cloudflare or a reverse proxy. The URL n8n actually sends differs from what's shown in the n8n UI.
workaround: Warn about the redirect_uri_mismatch issue behind reverse proxies. Ensure WEBHOOK_URL environment variable is set to the external-facing URL. Check that the proxy passes X-Forwarded-* headers and n8n's N8N_EDITOR_BASE_URL matches the external URL.

gotcha: HTTP Request node's built-in pagination may enter an infinite loop if cursor handling is not perfectly configured, or timeout after a few successful pages due to connection management issues (community reports May 2026).
workaround: Use a Code node to implement pagination manually with explicit page counting, cursor tracking, and a safety limit (max iterations). This gives full control over the pagination loop and prevents infinite loops.

gotcha: Wait node sets workflow to 'Waiting' status but never resumes after the delay on affected n8n versions (issue #29160, #31513). Workflow hangs indefinitely — no follow-up actions execute.
workaround: Instead of using a Wait node for long delays (hours), use a separate workflow triggered by a Schedule Trigger that checks if the follow-up is due. Or use an external scheduler (cron job, n8n schedule) to trigger the delayed action as a new execution.
